## Page 1

# Annual Review

The fiscal year closed with revenue of $412M, up 9% year over year, driven
primarily by the subscription segment.

<!-- page:2 -->
## Page 2

## Segment Performance

Subscription revenue reached $301M. Services revenue was flat at $77M.
Hardware declined to $34M as the transition away from on-premise appliances
continued.

<!-- page:3 -->
## Page 3

## Outlook

Management expects subscription growth to moderate to 6% next year as the
enterprise cohort reaches saturation.
